notes.title: CitiesCorp Concept Patch #1 out now
notes.content:
Hi All, 

Right after release, the game turned out to be too buggy and too difficult to play due to missing in game hints.

This patch #1 
- fixes the bugs that have been found (in case not, please let me know),
- includes an alpha version of in game hints.

The implementation of in game hints will continue and will be completed soon - for the time being it's alpha so that you can start to play and I can elaborate and fine tune the details.

If you want to see this summary in moving pictures, watch it 
on [url=https://youtu.be/bthQ0CY4pAE]YouTube[/url].

Please let me know, in case you find some further bugs.

For tutorials visit 

[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCX5Y6KGKZOHLr3bokiTKQiQ]my YouTube channel[/url]

German speaking audience: 
[url=https://www.youtube.com/user/umbrella198692]MicroHazarD - TV[/url]
special thanks to these guys, they are providing to me a great support with regards to fine tuning of the game.

In case I'll find some awesome channels that are providing support in your languages, I'll let you know them as well.

notes.title: First 36 Hours Live - A Short Update About Issues With The Game
notes.content:
Hi All,

first of all, thank you very much for all of your interest and support. 
I'm overwhelmed about everything and it really gives me additional energy to keep up the work. 
I'm still trying to catch up to answer all of your mails - so just give me some time to handle everything.

Nevertheless, I wanted to provide to you a short update about the first 36 hours of the game being live - I was mainly tracking all the issues that are appearing and I wanted to let you know about them - actually I started to work on fixing them, so I kindly ask you for some patience.

- Many people claim that due to missing tutorials, the game is really hard to explore - this is a fair point and I'm going to elaborate on it in several steps,

- Some features might be not that straightforward - when I was watching some videos, I saw some potential to make things more intuitive,

- UI overlays occur - this will be fixed asap,

- Game could freeze when executing a particular action - to be frank a first timer also for me - I'm looking into it.

- Potential issues with older Windows based set-ups - detective work ongoing.

If you find something additional, please let me know.

Please consider these things, before buying, because this hasn't been fixed, yet and it would be a pitty, if you would be disappointed just because of some bugs.

If you don't care, because you are a mighty player, go ahead!

For all of you who already bought the game - work in progress - I'm definitely not going to leave it like that. 

Have a great weekend!
Sebastian
